svg.title: Retsu and QQ master startup architecture
svg.desc: Eight trust zones enumerate 55 sourced components. Solid arrows show source wiring, dashed arrows show design targets. Select a service in the interactive version for state ownership and evidence.

g.aria-label: Athena; QQ Mac app; Source exists
g.title: Athena | QQ Mac app One native app; direct QQ and assistant modes. Source exists State owner: Native drafts and pending requests

g.aria-label: Artemis; QQ iOS app; Source exists
g.title: Artemis | QQ iOS app Same sessions from one enrolled phone. Source exists State owner: Device drafts, keys and pending requests

g.aria-label: Odysseus; QQ CLI and TUI; Source exists
g.title: Odysseus | QQ CLI and TUI Start and inspect local agent work. Source exists State owner: QQ owns session truth; TUI holds presentation

g.aria-label: Ariadne; QQClientCore / qq-client; Source exists
g.title: Ariadne | QQClientCore / qq-client Shared native and Rust client boundary. Source exists State owner: Versioned commands and snapshots; no money authority

g.aria-label: Hebe; Assistant web dashboard; Planned / unproved
g.title: Hebe | Assistant web dashboard Observe projects, tasks and service state. Planned / unproved State owner: Rust assistant product records

g.aria-label: Hera; Retsu web and account UI; Observed runtime
g.title: Hera | Retsu web and account UI Public entry, account and useful model requests. Observed runtime State owner: UI projects selected account; D1 owns account facts

g.text: Trusted OS user; separate durable stores

g.aria-label: Hermes; QQ engine and local server; Observed runtime
g.title: Hermes | QQ engine and local server The sole agent and provider execution engine. Observed runtime State owner: QQ sessions, runs, queues and command journal

g.aria-label: Clio; QQ session store; Source exists
g.title: Clio | QQ session store Persist transcripts, receipts and replay. Source exists State owner: QQ only

g.aria-label: Hestia; Rust assistant gateway; Source exists
g.title: Hestia | Rust assistant gateway Own product conversations, policy and recovery. Source exists State owner: Assistant product state and durable QQ outbox

g.aria-label: Mnemosyne; Assistant memory and tasks; Source exists
g.title: Mnemosyne | Assistant memory and tasks Scoped references, outcomes and artifact metadata. Source exists State owner: Private assistant SQLite and files

g.aria-label: Themis local; Assistant permission broker; Planned / unproved
g.title: Themis local | Assistant permission broker Admit exact approved tool and device effects. Planned / unproved State owner: Rust policy, registrations, epochs and effect receipts

g.aria-label: Talos; QQ tools, MCP and trusted adapters; Source exists
g.title: Talos | QQ tools, MCP and trusted adapters Execute approved workspace and service tools. Source exists State owner: QQ tool execution; adapter-owned external receipts
g.text: QQ tools, MCP and trusted adapters

g.aria-label: Circe; Skills and plugin catalogs; Source exists
g.title: Circe | Skills and plugin catalogs Supply instructions and reviewed tool catalogs. Source exists State owner: QQ catalog/configuration; permissions stay explicit

g.aria-label: Argus; Assistant host and device nodes; Planned / unproved
g.title: Argus | Assistant host and device nodes Bind host, enrolled devices and revocation. Planned / unproved State owner: Rust registrations, epochs and replay ledger

g.aria-label: Iris local; Embedded Tailscale transport; Source exists
g.title: Iris local | Embedded Tailscale transport Reach the approved host across devices. Source exists State owner: Transport identity only; product grants stay Rust-owned

g.aria-label: Zeus; Retsu API gateway; Observed runtime
g.title: Zeus | Retsu API gateway Route account and model requests. Observed runtime State owner: Request lifecycle; delegates durable authorities

g.aria-label: Cerberus; Auth, Better Auth Identity and Sessions; Source exists
g.title: Cerberus | Auth, Better Auth Identity and Sessions Bind the active account and organization. Source exists State owner: D1 user/session identity via Better Auth; API-key Auth service
g.text: Auth, Better Auth Identity and Sessions

g.aria-label: Metis; Model catalog and capabilities; Source exists
g.title: Metis | Model catalog and capabilities Describe models and advisory account state. Source exists State owner: Catalog metadata; admission evaluated separately

g.aria-label: Tyche; Billing and subscription entitlement; Source exists
g.title: Tyche | Billing and subscription entitlement Fulfill qualified offers and gate account usage. Source exists State owner: Billing owner; entitlement authority in Retsu

g.aria-label: Plutus; Stripe payment integration; Source exists
g.title: Plutus | Stripe payment integration Receive verified payment and economic events. Source exists State owner: Stripe payment truth; Retsu fulfills once

g.aria-label: Charon; AccountLedger Durable Object; Source exists
g.title: Charon | AccountLedger Durable Object Own credit, holds and once-only settlement. Source exists State owner: AccountLedger customer money and exposure

g.aria-label: Hades; Cloudflare D1 application database; Source exists
g.title: Hades | Cloudflare D1 application database Persist account and application facts. Source exists State owner: D1 application identity and records

g.aria-label: Eunomia; Accounts, Audit, Waitlist, Crypto and Settings; Source exists
g.title: Eunomia | Accounts, Audit, Waitlist, Crypto and Settings Support account policy and lifecycle. Source exists State owner: Retsu service owners with D1/audit state
g.text: Accounts, Audit, Waitlist, Crypto and Set…

g.aria-label: Sphinx; Turnstile and Edge abuse controls; Source exists
g.title: Sphinx | Turnstile and Edge abuse controls Protect configured sign-in, waitlist and signup paths. Source exists State owner: Edge configuration and D1 throttling records

g.aria-label: Apollo; QQ provider adapters and Retsu Backend; Source exists
g.title: Apollo | QQ provider adapters and Retsu Backend Dispatch through qualified model routes. Source exists State owner: Provider protocol inside QQ; paid admission in Retsu
g.text: QQ provider adapters and Retsu Backend

g.aria-label: Asclepius; Grip extraction and serving; Source exists
g.title: Asclepius | Grip extraction and serving Fill a caller schema with source-bound values. Source exists State owner: Grip model/server; Retsu owns paid settlement

g.aria-label: Athena counsel; Jev decision classifier; Source exists
g.title: Athena counsel | Jev decision classifier Advise on choices and declared candidates. Source exists State owner: Caller decision and authority; Jev returns advice

g.aria-label: Helios; Modal Grip backend; Source exists
g.title: Helios | Modal Grip backend Configured remote model-serving route. Source exists State owner: Supplier serving; Retsu request and cost reconciliation

g.aria-label: Prometheus; Configured external model suppliers; Source exists
g.title: Prometheus | Configured external model suppliers Provide models through existing adapters. Source exists State owner: Supplier outputs and cost; QQ credentials remain protected

g.aria-label: Poseidon; Mesh hosted-run control; Source exists
g.title: Poseidon | Mesh hosted-run control Receive an exact admitted hosted attempt. Source exists State owner: Trusted control plane run/attempt contract

g.aria-label: Moirai; Trusted PostgreSQL run records; Planned / unproved
g.title: Moirai | Trusted PostgreSQL run records Own admission, attempts, fences and uncertainty. Planned / unproved State owner: Trusted run/attempt authority

g.aria-label: Chronos; Temporal durable execution; Source exists
g.title: Chronos | Temporal durable execution Continue admitted work through retries and recovery. Source exists State owner: One workflow history per admitted run

g.aria-label: Atlas; Qualified AWS workers and queues; Source exists
g.title: Atlas | Qualified AWS workers and queues Execute fenced bounded attempts. Source exists State owner: Worker effect receipts; control plane owns admission

g.aria-label: Oceanus; Hosted object storage / S3; Planned / unproved
g.title: Oceanus | Hosted object storage / S3 Store immutable run inputs and results. Planned / unproved State owner: Artifact catalog and digest-addressed objects

g.aria-label: Selene; AWS staging environment; Planned / unproved
g.title: Selene | AWS staging environment Verify isolated release artifacts and recovery. Planned / unproved State owner: Separate environment resources and state

g.aria-label: Hyperion; AWS production environment; Planned / unproved
g.title: Hyperion | AWS production environment Promote the same qualified staging artifacts. Planned / unproved State owner: Separate production resources and state

g.text: Local reviewer boundary; hosted target separate

g.aria-label: Demeter; platform2 local data application; Source exists
g.title: Demeter | platform2 local data application Import, propose labels, review and export. Source exists State owner: Two SQLite stores and contained object roots

g.aria-label: Persephone; Label proposals and independent assessment; Source exists
g.title: Persephone | Label proposals and independent assessment Keep producer and reviewer decisions distinct. Source exists State owner: Immutable proposals and LabelAssessment revisions

g.aria-label: Daedalus; Reviewed experiment definitions; Source exists
g.title: Daedalus | Reviewed experiment definitions Prepare immutable qualified experiment inputs. Source exists State owner: Local experiment and publication intent journals

g.aria-label: Gaia; Local SQLite catalog and objects; Source exists
g.title: Gaia | Local SQLite catalog and objects Preserve datasets, digests and review history. Source exists State owner: platform2 catalog plus local model-loop store

g.aria-label: Triptolemus; Hosted data API, MCP and training target; Planned / unproved
g.title: Triptolemus | Hosted data API, MCP and training target Serve future tenant-safe data workflows. Planned / unproved State owner: Existing identity/run owners plus data catalog
g.text: Hosted data API, MCP and training target

g.aria-label: Hephaestus; GitHub repositories and CI/CD; Source exists
g.title: Hephaestus | GitHub repositories and CI/CD Preserve source, review and release artifacts. Source exists State owner: One owner per branch; exact-head review and CI

g.aria-label: Nike; Staging and production promotion; Source exists
g.title: Nike | Staging and production promotion Deploy reviewed immutable environment artifacts. Source exists State owner: Protected branch/environment release authority

g.aria-label: Cyclopes; Terraform, Packer, Nix and Docker; Source exists
g.title: Cyclopes | Terraform, Packer, Nix and Docker Build and describe worker/environment artifacts. Source exists State owner: Reviewed infrastructure and immutable image identity

g.aria-label: Aether; Cloudflare DNS and TLS; Observed runtime
g.title: Aether | Cloudflare DNS and TLS Route public API/web and future environments. Observed runtime State owner: DNS/TLS provider configuration

g.aria-label: Aegis; IAM, secrets and Keychain custody; Source exists
g.title: Aegis | IAM, secrets and Keychain custody Hold narrowly scoped service and device access. Source exists State owner: OS credential store and provider IAM authority

g.aria-label: Panoptes; Sentry error observability; Planned / unproved
g.title: Panoptes | Sentry error observability Report privacy-safe failures and triage. Planned / unproved State owner: Sentry project and source-owned diagnostic policy

g.aria-label: Echo; QQ events, audit and OTel metrics; Source exists
g.title: Echo | QQ events, audit and OTel metrics Observe outcomes without changing authority. Source exists State owner: Service-owned events, audit and metrics
g.text: QQ events, audit and OTel metrics

g.aria-label: Metis watch; Cloudflare Analytics Engine and Monitor; Source exists
g.title: Metis watch | Cloudflare Analytics Engine and Monitor Record requests and run bounded alert checks/digests. Source exists State owner: Analytics Engine metric dataset; D1 alert history and cooldown

g.aria-label: Calliope; QQ documentation website; Source exists
g.title: Calliope | QQ documentation website Explain setup, current systems and acceptance. Source exists State owner: Guide source and this static architecture registry

g.aria-label: Iris; Resend transactional mail; Source exists
g.title: Iris | Resend transactional mail Send authorized account emails. Source exists State owner: Retsu Mailer plus provider receipt

g.aria-label: Peitho; HubSpot acquisition integration; Planned / unproved
g.title: Peitho | HubSpot acquisition integration Track qualified consented customer context. Planned / unproved State owner: CRM records and acquisition owner

g.aria-label: Psyche; PostHog product analytics; Planned / unproved
g.title: Psyche | PostHog product analytics Measure actual consented first and repeat use. Planned / unproved State owner: Analytics events and participant consent

g.aria-label: Harmonia; Consented pilot and service connections; Planned / unproved
g.title: Harmonia | Consented pilot and service connections Bind a real useful workflow and acceptance role. Planned / unproved State owner: Actual participant, rights and acceptance receipt

g.aria-label: Pheme; Slack / Discord alert integrations; Source exists
g.title: Pheme | Slack / Discord alert integrations Deliver configured operational alerts with mail fallback. Source exists State owner: Monitor D1 alert records plus actual channel delivery receipts

svg.text: SOURCE means code exists, not deployed or journey accepted. TARGET means specified wiring still needs proof.
